Treatment summary
Patient presented following a rear-end motor vehicle collision with complaints of low
back pain and stiffness. Over the course of 21 visits, care consisted of conservative
management including physical therapy, home exercise instruction, and as-needed
anti-inflammatory medication. Treatment progressed in a typical pattern, with visit
frequency reduced as symptoms gradually improved and the patient was discharged to
self-directed exercise. On examination, paraspinal muscle tenderness and reduced
lumbar range of motion were documented, while neurological screening, including
reflexes, strength, and sensation in the lower extremities, remained within normal
limits. The patient reports no prior history of injury or treatment involving the
lumbar region. The billing record reflects single, non-duplicated charges for each
service rendered. Given the low-speed nature of the impact described by the patient,
the severity of the reported symptmos is noted for the record, though the clinical
findings above are documented as observed.
